independence_declaration.statement: I am domain-reviewer, run T-DG1-REV-DOM-R2. I did not author any implementation, register text or decision in the DG1 scope or in the round-2 repairs, which were made by the solution-architect, backend-workflow-engineer, frontend-ux-engineer, devops-engineer, transformation-analyst and delivery-orchestrator. I formed this verdict before reading any other reviewer's round-2 record; none was visible to me. The findings I verify here are ones I reported in round 1 (F-DG1-001..006), plus F-DG1-105 and F-DG1-207, assigned to me as a non-author. I grant no business, Finance or IT approval. Product gate G6 is not engineering gate DG7.

summary: PASS. All eight assigned fixes verify on candidate 991d3241: F-DG1-001, 002, 003, 004, 005, 006, 105 and 207, each closed with a CLOSED_VERIFIED sidecar. Closure is refused live with 422 invalid-transition citing G6, nothing is written, and neither the web nor any engineering path offers or grants it. The Arabic glossary terms hold, with Transformation and Initiative kept distinct. The six §16 modules exist with their own suites (D-048 and D-050 accepted). The register counts are correct. A BU-scoped TL creator now opens its own record, and the transformation audit labels are localized. Domain invariants hold: provisional tokens and wordmark, no official Mobily or PMI claim, Arabic RTL and English LTR rendered, bundled fonts with no off-origin requests, Unknown never shown as zero, and DG kept separate from G. Unit tests 210/210, integration 193/193 on PostgreSQL 16.13, and the live scenario passed with 0 failures. Two new Low, non-mandatory findings: F-DG1-007 (register residuals: REQ-PB-009 notes say 409; REQ-S19-004 notes cite migrations 0001-0006) and F-DG1-008 (the derived scoped_assignment.create audit entry renders a raw action and untranslated fields in Arabic and English).
